encode_messages: encode a list of chat messages into a DeepSeek V3.2 formatted prompt string with optional thinking mode
render_message: render a single chat message from a list into the DeepSeek V3.2 prompt format for a given role and index
parse_message_from_completion_text: parse a model completion text into structured content, reasoning, and tool calls for DeepSeek V3.2 format
render_tools: render a list of tool schemas into the DeepSeek V3.2 tools system template string
encode_arguments_to_dsml: encode a tool call dictionary into DSML parameter markup format
